notes.title: Big Quality Update for Has-Been Heroes
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/F6np6cU.jpg[/img]

This update has been long overdue but it's finally here! We have updated Has-Been Heroes with some cool new features, and fixed a lot of issues that have been reported to us. So thank you all for your input, and we hope you enjoy the new stuff!

Below is the changelog! :)

[list]
[*]Added information about the heroes to the Heroes menu
[*]Added more spell effects (visual)
[*]Gameplay:
[list][*] Herald of Gales boss melee hits from 6 to 5 and Max Stamina from 18 to 16
[*]Fire now removes freeze on enemies who are immune to fire
[*]Fixed the Charm bug (does not hit heroes when charm ends)
[*]Fixed Final Boss wet+wind bottom row issue
[*]Fixed miscellaneous minor bugs
[*]Fixed issues in tutorial helpers
[*]Fixed dialogue text box "shadow copy"
[*]Fixes to the backstab issues
[/list]
[*]Polished sound design
[*]Polished spell effects
[*]Polished text box wordwrap
[*]Polished endings (incl. final story ending)
[/list]

Overall these should be some noticeable quality improvements!

For all our lurking console players (we know you're there!), the update is out today on PS4, Nintendo Switch and Xbox One also.

Also remember to check or try to get your way to the [url=http://has-beenheroes.com/]Hall of Heroes[/url]! Our 100% completionists marked there are now totalling at 11 brave warriors! On average their completion took 162 hours and 177 games. That's quite something!

...which leaves out just the final bit of news! It's also Summer sale time on Steam, and Has-Been Heroes will be on sale for the first time ever, available for [b]-50%[/b], for a meagre price of $9.99 USD! If you've been on the fence so far, now's the time to pick up the most challenging game of the year. ;)

Let us know what you think of the changes! Also good summer days to everyone!
